text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'm visiting an art gallery with
Light Hello
to take a break from the
hustle and bustle.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Wow... what an amazing exhibit! So
many famous
works were on display.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Truly breathtaking. I'm almost
overwhelmed with
inspiration!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Yes! I thought the flow was incredible!
choice_data_list: 気に入った物はありましたか？

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
The path the visitors take through the
gallery!
You can tell that careful
attention was paid to the
lighting and
the order in which the pieces were

arranged.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
It was all calculated to a T and really
helped
accentuate the beauty of the
artwork.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Oh... hehe. I suppose it is strange to
fixate on the
arrangement of the gallery
before the art itself.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I can't switch off my work brain...
No, I
think I've had this habit for as long
as I can
remember.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I've always preferred to support others
in their
endeavors over chasing big
dreams for myself.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Though, perhaps I simply didn't have the
talent to
achieve greatness. Haha...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
choice_data_list: その想いも1つの才能です

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you for saying so. I, uh, well...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Um... Wow! Look at that! They're holding
a
painting workshop!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Applying the things you've learned is a
vital part
of project planning! How about
we give it a go?
Come on!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Well, I've finished at least, but
painting
landscapes is quite the
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Copying what you see sounds simple
enough. But
in practice, not so much...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: How did you do, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Wow! You're being too modest! That's a
beautiful
painting!
choice_data_list: とりあえず、描けました

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
The line work is splendid! The thickness
and
depth lend a nice touch to the
overall vibe of the
painting.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
And the gentle expressions of the
passersby melts
my heart! You have a
great personality and a
knack for art to
boot... What can't you do?!
choice_data_list: あ、ありがとうございます

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! Compared to me, you're a
master
artist.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her modesty, Light Hello did a
good job
of capturing the characteristics
of the landscape.
She really has a keen
eye for these things.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
See? Our paintings are like night and
day.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you don't have to coddle me! I'm
very much
aware of my lack of talent.
choice_data_list: 素晴らしい絵だと思いますよ

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Um... What about the flaws? I can
handle
constructive criticism...
choice_data_list: 植物の特徴をよく捉えてますし

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
B-but! The perspective is totally off.
Having a
keen eye for details doesn't
mean I can replicate
them on paper very
well!

text_block_list.name: Workshop Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, but observational skills are vital
when it
comes to depicting things
through artwork.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Workshop Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I agree with your friend, for yours
is a
wonderful painting.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I-I suppose so... And I should be able to
apply
what I've learned here when
planning events.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
But you know... I'm not used to receiving

compliments. So, um...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...I'm really at my limit!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Embarrassed, Light Hello scurries off to
get ready
to leave. However, I notice her
carefully tuck
away the painting into her
bag.
